### 1. Shipping Cost of a Common Medium-Sized Box in UPS Flat-Rate Shipping (UPS Simple Rate)

On UPS.com, flat-rate shipping is offered under **UPS Simple Rate**. 

#### **Medium Box Specifications:**
* **Volume Range:** 251 to 650 cubic inches
* **Common Box Dimensions:** 
  * 8 in x 8 in x 8 in (512 cu. in.)
  * 12 in x 9 in x 6 in (648 cu. in.)
  * 13 in x 11 in x 2 in (286 cu. in.)
  * 13 in x 12 in x 4 in (624 cu. in.)
* **Size Samples / Typical Contents:** Shoebox, three-inch three-ring binder, tissue box, ream of paper
* **Maximum Weight:** Up to 50 lbs
* **Packaging:** Shippers can use their own custom packaging or boxes (as long as they fit within 251–650 cubic inches) or purchase UPS-branded boxes.

#### **Shipping Rates for a Medium Box (Between the 48 Contiguous States):**
The base shipping cost for a common medium-sized box starts at **$18.95** (Daily Rates) or **$21.65** (Retail Rates) for ground delivery, with pricing tiered across four delivery speeds:

| Service Option / Speed | Delivery Timeframe | Daily Rate | Retail Rate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **UPS Ground** | Within 5 business days | **$18.95** | **$21.65** |
| **UPS 3 Day Select** | Within 3 business days | **$33.70** | **$35.45** |
| **UPS 2nd Day Air** | 2nd business day | **$37.50** | **$46.55** |
| **UPS Next Day Air Saver** | Next business day | **$50.45** | **$63.85** |

*(Note: Rates from the 48 contiguous states to Alaska and Hawaii are $56.00 Ground / $63.70 2nd Day Air for Metro AK/HI, and $69.35 Ground / $109.65 2nd Day Air for Remote AK/HI under Daily Rates).*

---

### 2. Comparison with Other Parcel Services

According to UPS's published comparisons and rate guides, UPS Simple Rate compares to competing flat-rate and standard parcel services as follows:

#### **A. Comparison with Competitor Flat-Rate Services (FedEx One Rate & USPS Flat Rate):**

| Feature | UPS Simple Rate | FedEx One Rate | USPS Priority Mail Flat Rate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Customer Packaging Allowed** | **Yes** (Use your own box up to 1,728 cu. in.) | **No** (Must use FedEx-branded packaging) | **No** (Must use USPS-branded packaging) |
| **Maximum Volume** | **Up to 1,728 cu. in.** (Medium: up to 650 cu. in.) | Up to 1,452 cu. in. | Up to 1,200 cu. in. |
| **Available Service Speeds** | **4 Speeds** (Ground, 3-Day, 2nd Day Air, Next Day Air Saver) | Express services only (No Ground option) | 1 Option: Priority Mail (1–3 business days) |
| **Pricing Model** | **National Flat Rate** (Same price to all 48 states) | **3 Distance Zones** (Price increases across local, regional, and national tiers) | **National Flat Rate** (Same price nationwide) |
| **Included Declared Value** | **$100** | $100 | $50 |
| **Day-Definite Guarantee** | **Guaranteed** | Guaranteed | Not guaranteed |

#### **B. Comparison with Standard Weight/Zone-Based Parcel Services (e.g., Standard UPS Ground / FedEx Ground):**
* **Predictability vs. Distance/Weight:** Standard parcel rates are calculated based on destination zone (Zones 2–8) and either actual weight or dimensional (DIM) weight. If a medium box weighs close to the 50-pound limit or travels across country (Zone 8), standard parcel rates increase substantially, whereas flat-rate shipping maintains a fixed rate ($18.95 Ground) regardless of weight (up to 50 lbs) or distance within the contiguous 48 states.
* **Surcharges:** Standard parcel shipments frequently incur additional fees such as fuel surcharges, residential delivery surcharges (e.g., $7.00 for Air / $6.50 for Ground), and delivery area surcharges (DAS/Extended). UPS Simple Rate explicitly **waives fuel surcharges, residential surcharges, and delivery area surcharges**.
